name: H-E-B eCommerce Fulfillment Center - Plano - Plano TX

fieldNotes.facility: The Plano eFC (~55,000 sq ft, opened 2023) is NOT a stand-alone freight building - it is attached to / integrated with the H-E-B Plano retail grocery store at 6001 Preston Rd. The audit therefore reads a retail-store back-of-house dock, not a distribution yard.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled freight gate. Truck access is an open back-of-house service drive that runs along the screened west wall and connects to the shopping-center parking-lot circulation; no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on the truck route.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Small grocery-store dock at the SW corner of the building - approx 2-4 dock positions; 2 trailers seen backed in. Banded 0-10. Door count is an estimate (screen wall and canopy partially obscure overhead view).
fieldNotes.dropArea: No trailer drop / parking lot - trailers are only at the active dock. NONE.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: The back-of-house service drive holds only 1-2 trucks at the dock recess.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense north-Dallas suburban retail corridor on Preston Rd (Plano).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Service drive is a single shared two-way lane; entry/exit lane counts are nominal.
